declarations.name: ThemeSwitcherElement
declarations.description: A light-DOM tri-state theme preference control. Initially restores a valid localStorage preference, then an optional cookie, then the component value attribute, then the checked authored radio, then System. Does not read an initial html[data-theme]. Applies the literal preference to html[data-theme], persists it when enabled, and synchronizes controls and tabs. Authored radio markup wins over choices, name, and label attributes. A supported component value overrides only the initial selection, not authored reset defaults. Includes system, light, and dark; additional themes are author-defined.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Nonempty localStorage key and default cookie name when cookie is enabled. Changing it reads the new saved preference.

attributes.name: storage
attributes.description: Uses localStorage by default. None disables both localStorage and optional cookies, without deleting saved values or isolating same-document controls.

attributes.name: cookie
attributes.description: Opt-in cookie mirror and fallback. An empty attribute uses storage-key; a value chooses a separate cookie name. LocalStorage takes precedence at startup. Cookies use Path=/, SameSite=Lax, and Secure on HTTPS. Storage none overrides this option.

attributes.name: cookie-max-age
attributes.description: Positive cookie lifetime in seconds. Cookies also synchronize through Cookie Store change events where supported, with focus/visibility checks as a fallback.

attributes.name: system-label
attributes.description: System label for default generated choices only.

attributes.name: light-label
attributes.description: Light label for default generated choices only.

attributes.name: dark-label
attributes.description: Dark label for default generated choices only.

members.name: value
members.description: Current radio selection. Assignments before initial theme setup are ignored. After initial readiness, set a nonempty offered string to apply and persist a preference without changing the reset default. During later pending states, values are queued and validated against the prepared choices; ready rejects unsupported queued values. Unsupported ready-state assignments throw. Null before setup or when this control does not offer the active page theme, including on connection; assigning null throws.

members.name: resolvedTheme
members.description: System resolves to light or dark using prefers-color-scheme; custom themes pass through. Null before setup.

members.name: cookie
members.description: Effective cookie name or null when not configured. Setter accepts a name, true to use storage-key, or false/null/undefined to disable the cookie.

members.name: ready
members.description: Current enhancement and theme setup promise. Rejects on configuration or inherited enhancement failure. Read again after reconfiguration. Storage failures are nonfatal.

members.name: state
members.description: Inherited enhancement state, including theme configuration errors.

events.name: theme-switcher:change
events.description: Bubbles after a preference or resolved theme changes, including initialization. Detail: value, previousValue, resolvedTheme, previousResolvedTheme, source. Sources: initial, user, api, attribute, configuration, reset, storage, sync, system. Does not replace inherited user-interaction events.

events.name: theme-switcher:ready
events.description: Bubbles after native enhancement and successful theme setup. Detail: value, resolvedTheme.

events.name: theme-switcher:error
events.description: Bubbling diagnostic, also logged to console.error. Detail: error, phase (configuration, storage, synchronization). Storage and synchronization diagnostics are nonfatal.

declarations.name: defineThemeSwitcher
declarations.description: Guarded registration for theme-switcher; called on import.
